description: This file defines the ModuleBuilder class within the Step\Acceptance namespace, providing methods to automate interactions with the module builder interface in SuiteCRM, including creating modules and packages, selecting existing ones, and deploying packages.

classes.name: ModuleBuilder
classes.description: A class providing methods to automate module creation, selection, and deployment within SuiteCRM's Module Builder interface in acceptance tests.

methods.name: createModule
methods.description: Automates the creation of a new module within the Module Builder, including package creation if necessary and module type selection based on the provided moduleType.

methods.name: selectPackage
methods.description: Selects an existing package in the Module Builder to prepare for further actions.

methods.name: selectModule
methods.description: Selects a specific module within a package in the Module Builder interface.

methods.name: waitUntilPopupSuccessDisappeared
methods.description: Waits for the success message popup to disappear, indicating that an operation has completed.

methods.name: deployPackage
methods.description: Deploys a specified package in the Module Builder interface, with optional handling of existing packages.
